sections.description:

👉 Official Website: WP Social Ninja

👉 Get Demo: View The Demo

👉 Guidelines: Official Documentation

👉 Join Our Community: WP Social Ninja Community

🔥WP Social Ninja – A Comprehensive Social Media Plugin

WP Social Ninja is a social media marketing tool designed to build trust, create urgency, and encourage conversions. This easy-to-use plugin lets you meet all your targets. You can embed Instagram Feed, Facebook Feed, YouTube Feed, TikTok Feed, and other platforms. For example, you can display your social feed gallery with user-generated content using hashtags and even embed product feed from Instagram shoppable feeds for direct sales.

This business reviews plugin also collects and displays customer reviews from 9+ popular platforms, helping you build trust. You can display these reviews on dedicated pages or as notification popups. You can connect reviews from Google Business Profile, Yelp, Airbnb, Facebook, WooCommerce, and other platforms.

Need a social chat or customer support solution? Don’t worry, using WP Social Ninja, you can connect 15+ social chat widgets. You can add chat buttons to your site, such as WhatsApp Chat, Messenger Chat, Telegram Chat, and other chat widgets. This user-friendly social plugin offers unlimited features, customization, and styling options.

👉Get the Pro Version | View the Demo

🔌 Embed Preferred Platforms in 3 Quick Steps:

Connect any types of feeds to your site in just three simple steps with WP Social Ninja:

  • Connect and create your desired feed
  • Customize and style to match your brand
  • Copy the shortcode and display it on the website

👉 Get the Pro | Learn Detail Steps

🖼️ Social Feeds Key Platforms & Features

Connect and embed Instagram feeds, Facebook Feeds, YouTube Feeds, or TikTok Feeds anywhere on your website. You can design eye-catching social feed galleries by choosing a stylish layout and customizing them.

Instagram Feed

Integrate Instagram feeds in WordPress to display Instagram photos on your website. This Instagram widget and Instagram Shoppable feed can improve your e-commerce business growth. The shoppable feature is only available for the Instagram feed Pro version.

Facebook Feed

Create a personalized Facebook feed on a website with our Facebook feed feature. Using this Facebook feed plugin, you can show Facebook Album Feed and the Facebook Event Feed without using multiple plugins.

YouTube Feed

Embed YouTube feed on WordPress website with WP Social Ninja and let your audience be introduced to your YouTube channel through our plugin.

TikTok Feed

Decorate your website with your TikTok posts through a customized TikTok feed by our TikTok plugin and promote your business to increase engagement.

⭐ Business Reviews Platforms & Features

Show your Customer Reviews using WP Social Ninja! With pre-built templates, you can easily highlight Google Reviews, Facebook Reviews, and other review platforms. You can also collect and display custom review feeds and filter reviews to boost customer trust, improve SEO scores, and drive more sales.

💬 Chat Widgets Key Platforms & Features

WP Social Ninja makes it easy for your website visitors to connect with you instantly through popular messaging platforms. With 15+ supported chat widgets, you can add a floating chat button to your website and provide real-time customer communication.

Whether it’s WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, or other platforms, you can link your business accounts and keep your support accessible anywhere on your site.

sections.installation:
This section describes how to install and get the plugin working.
Install from WordPress Admin Panel:
1. Log in to your WordPress Admin Area
2. Go to Plugins -> Add New
3. Type “WP Social Ninja” into the Search and hit Enter
4. Find this plugin, click “Install Now”
5. Activate The Plugin
6. Use [wp_social_ninja id=”template_id” platform=”platform_name”] Shortcode on your next page or post

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from the WordPress.org repository
  2. On your WordPress admin dashboard, go to Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the downloaded plugin file (wp-social-reviews.zip) and click Install Now
  4. Activate “WP Social Ninja” from your Plugins page
  5. Use WP Social Ninja on your site from the dashboard
sections.faq:
How many social reviews can be displayed on the website?

You can display an unlimited number of reviews and ratings from Google reviews or Facebook reviews, WooCommerce reviews on your website from the Number of Reviews section.

How do I connect my Instagram feed?

Connecting your Instagram feed is easy with WP Social Ninja. You will get multiple configuration options; you can choose the most convenient one.

Instagram feed is not loading. How to fix it?

There could be several reasons that cause your feed not to load and show. Check out the link for detailed information.

Can I display feeds from multiple Facebook pages?

Surely you can! You can display Facebook posts and Facebook feeds from multiple Facebook pages. Also, you can create multiple Facebook feed templates and choose any one of them to showcase on your site.

How do I customize my Facebook feed?

WP Social Ninja gives you fully customizable template options where you can customize and style your custom Facebook feed and Facebook posts.

Can I hand-pick specific posts to hide or show in my Instagram feed?

Yes. You can easily do that with the filter options from the editor panel, where you can hide or show specific Instagram photos or posts by choosing specific keywords or hashtags.

Can I hide specific reviews and ratings on my website?

Yes, you can. WP Social Ninja is a fully featured review plugin with unique features. To hide a particular review on your website, you need to upgrade to the Pro version.

Is WP Social Ninja compatible with my theme or design?

WP Social Ninja works perfectly with themes Elementor, Gutenberg, Beaver Builder, and Oxygen Builder.

How can I get support if the plugin is not working?

If you face any problem with WP Social Ninja or if something is not working as it should, follow these basic steps:
First, make sure the error is not caused by the theme you are using, and if your themes are compatible with WP Social Ninja.
Deactivate other plugins and check if the problem is still occurring.
Ensure that you’re using the latest version of this plugin and your themes. Also, check if the problem you are experiencing has not already been solved in a later plugin update.
Still, if any of these don’t work for you, then submit a support ticket and explain your problem accurately when our support agent responds to you.

Where can I report bugs?

You can report your bugs in our support ticket. Our support team is 24/7 available to assist you.

Where can I report security issues?

We handle all security issues with the Patchstack vdp program. Please report any security issues here.

I want to contribute to the plugin. Where can I find the code repository?

The code repository for WP Social Ninja is hosted on GitHub. You can find it here.

Do you want to encourage us for future improvement?

If you like this plugin, please give us 5 stars to encourage us for future improvement. Thank you!

description:
Easy to Use and Feature-rich Social Media Plugin to Connect Feeds, Reviews, Chat Widgets, Notification Popups, and More.

👉 Official Website: WP Social Ninja

👉 Get Demo: View The Demo

👉 Guidelines: Official Documentation

👉 Join Our Community: WP Social Ninja Community

🔥WP Social Ninja – A Comprehensive Social Media Plugin

WP Social Ninja is a social media marketing tool designed to build trust, create urgency, and encourage conversions. This easy-to-use plugin lets you meet all your targets. You can embed Instagram Feed, Facebook Feed, YouTube Feed, TikTok Feed, and other platforms. For example, you can display your social feed gallery with user-generated content using hashtags and even embed product feed from Instagram shoppable feeds for direct sales.

This business reviews plugin also collects and displays customer reviews from 9+ popular platforms, helping you build trust. You can display these reviews on dedicated pages or as notification popups. You can connect reviews from Google Business Profile, Yelp, Airbnb, Facebook, WooCommerce, and other platforms.

Need a social chat or customer support solution? Don’t worry, using WP Social Ninja, you can connect 15+ social chat widgets. You can add chat buttons to your site, such as WhatsApp Chat, Messenger Chat, Telegram Chat, and other chat widgets. This user-friendly social plugin offers unlimited features, customization, and styling options.

👉Get the Pro Version | View the Demo

🔌 Embed Preferred Platforms in 3 Quick Steps:

Connect any types of feeds to your site in just three simple steps with WP Social Ninja:

  • Connect and create your desired feed
  • Customize and style to match your brand
  • Copy the shortcode and display it on the website

👉 Get the Pro | Learn Detail Steps

🖼️ Social Feeds Key Platforms & Features

Connect and embed Instagram feeds, Facebook Feeds, YouTube Feeds, or TikTok Feeds anywhere on your website. You can design eye-catching social feed galleries by choosing a stylish layout and customizing them.

Instagram Feed

Integrate Instagram feeds in WordPress to display Instagram photos on your website. This Instagram widget and Instagram Shoppable feed can improve your e-commerce business growth. The shoppable feature is only available for the Instagram feed Pro version.

Facebook Feed

Create a personalized Facebook feed on a website with our Facebook feed feature. Using this Facebook feed plugin, you can show Facebook Album Feed and the Facebook Event Feed without using multiple plugins.

YouTube Feed

Embed YouTube feed on WordPress website with WP Social Ninja and let your audience be introduced to your YouTube channel through our plugin.

TikTok Feed

Decorate your website with your TikTok posts through a customized TikTok feed by our TikTok plugin and promote your business to increase engagement.

Explore Social Feed features (Free):

  • Designed for all users
  • Easy integration
  • Limited layouts and templates
  • Basic customization
  • Custom feed header
  • Control YouTube feed playback with autoplay
  • YouTube feeds with custom play mode
  • Load More to keep visitors engaged
  • Feed issue Email alerts
  • Page builder compatible
  • Auto Sync to keep content fresh
  • Save Images Locally
  • GDPR Compliant

Explore Social Feed Features (Pro):

  • Connect and manage multiple business accounts
  • Versatile feed types from Hashtag, Photos, Videos, or Live Streams
  • Facebook Event Feed
  • Facebook Album Feed
  • Shoppable Instagram Feed
  • Multiple layout options like Grid, Carousel, or Masonry
  • Filter by date range for Facebook feed
  • “Follow Us” Button to Increase followers
  • Deep template styling
  • Lightbox popups to display feed content on popups
  • Show likes, comments, and captions
  • Filter posts by keyword/hashtag

👉 Check All Feed Features

⭐ Business Reviews Platforms & Features

Show your Customer Reviews using WP Social Ninja! With pre-built templates, you can easily highlight Google Reviews, Facebook Reviews, and other review platforms. You can also collect and display custom review feeds and filter reviews to boost customer trust, improve SEO scores, and drive more sales.

Google Reviews (Free)

Embed Google Business Profile reviews using our Google reviews plugin to improve trust and grow your business.

Airbnb Reviews (Free)

Display Airbnb reviews to engage customers and encourage quick decisions.

WooCommerce Reviews (Pro)

Collect customer reviews for WooCommerce and highlight your WooCommerce product reviews on your WooCommerce website to build loyalty and drive more sales.

Facebook Reviews (Pro)

Display Facebook reviews and recommendations to improve business credibility.

Fluent Forms reviews (Pro)

Collect and display on-site Fluent Forms reviews and display your custom reviews on your website.

Other Pro customer review Platforms: Yelp Reviews, Booking.com Reviews, Tripadvisor Reviews, AliExpress Reviews, Custom reviews, and Others. (Pro)

Explore Business Reviews Features (Free):

  • Customizable layouts & templates
  • Auto & manual syncing for review updates
  • Specify the number of reviews
  • Show review by order
  • Language-specific reviews fetch (for Tripadvisor & Booking.com)
  • Maintain equal height
  • Enable external links
  • Optimize the review image
  • Pagination for the load more button
  • GDPR Compliance
  • Shortcodes are supported
  • SEO-Optimized and Schema Snippet support
  • Shorten long reviews and display clean, concise feedback
  • Anonymize reviewer Info and hide names or profile photos
  • Hide specific reviews and exclude reviews you don’t want to show
  • Optimize review count, column structure, and layout for all devices

Explore Business Reviews Features (Pro):

  • Combine & display multiple site reviews in a single feed
  • Manage and display multiple business accounts
  • Filter by Rating and show only the best reviews
  • AI overview for all reviews
  • Verified reviewers badge
  • Hide reviews without text
  • Sort reviews by rating
  • Display review header
  • Styling option for better review presentation
  • Import/export custom reviews

👉 Check All Review Features

💬 Chat Widgets Key Platforms & Features

WP Social Ninja makes it easy for your website visitors to connect with you instantly through popular messaging platforms. With 15+ supported chat widgets, you can add a floating chat button to your website and provide real-time customer communication.

Whether it’s WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, or other platforms, you can link your business accounts and keep your support accessible anywhere on your site.

WhatsApp Chat (Free)

Provide real-time assistance via WhatsApp chat to close sales faster and enhance customer satisfaction, all without complex setups.

Messenger Chat (Free)

Give proper customer support with Messenger Chat to boost trust and grow your business.

Telegram Chat (Free)

Take your user engagement to another level with our Telegram Chat Widget.

Other Pro Social Chat Platforms: Instagram Page Chat, Instagram DM, Phone, SMS, Email, LinkedIn Chat, X (Twitter), Microsoft Teams Chat, Snapchat, WeChat, Slack, and others. (Pro)

Explore Social Chat Features (Free):

  • Messenger, WhatsApp & WhatsApp Business chat support
  • One-click chat launch
  • Add multiple chat accounts
  • Different templates and layout types
  • Customize chat button text
  • Set chat header (Profile/page name, picture/logo)
  • Floating button placement
  • Set chat button position
  • Custom prefilled welcome message
  • Include pages to display chat
  • Display chat button by post type
  • Chat opens in popup window
  • Hide chat on desktop/mobile
  • Show label (works on chat box)
  • Set the close button color
  • Style the header background, title, caption, and color
  • Set priority for widgets to show on appropriate pages

Explore Social Chat Features (Pro):

  • Custom pre-set welcome messages
  • Multiple chat bubble icons
  • Upload custom chat bubble icon
  • Customize bubble text
  • Specify chat language
  • Exclude pages to hide chat
  • Show online/offline status
  • Create a different chat widget for different languages

👉 Check All Chat Features

🔔 Notification Popup

Display Notification Popups on any website page to instantly grab your visitors’ attention and build trust in your brand.

Whether it’s a 5-star rating, a customer recommendation, or a recent review from platforms like Google, Facebook, WooCommerce, or any other supported review source, you can showcase them in real time using the notification feature.

These popups add credibility to your business, enhance user engagement, increase social proof, and boost your brand value where it matters most.

👉 Check Notification Popup Features

📝 Testimonial

Highlight your best customer feedback using WP Social Ninja’s Testimonial feature. With complete customization options, you can design and style the testimonials slider to create an engaging and professional look.

Why use WP Social Ninja for Testimonials?

WP Social Ninja is one of the most dynamic testimonial slider plugins for WordPress websites. It allows you to:

  • Easily create and manage testimonials
  • Display them on any post, page, or template
  • Customize the layout, styling, and design to match your branding

We have an integration with Fluent Forms, so you can collect your Testimonials using Fluent Forms and display them on your website to improve credibility.

👉 Check Testimonial Features

🔥 Social Feeds, Reviews & Chats Demos

Want to see how social proof looks on a website? Visit our demo page. You can see examples of Instagram Feed, YouTube Feed, Google Reviews, Facebook Reviews, along with social chat widgets – WhatsApp Chat, Messenger Chat, and others.

🔥 Page Builder and Other Integrations

  • Elementor
  • Gutenberg
  • Beaver Builder
  • Oxygen Builder
  • Fluent Forms

🗣️ End-user Reviews and Rating

This is the pure gold. It is an all-in-one plugin you must have on your web. Especially if you want to show your best testimonials from customers or just looking for the best social feed plugin. Now I don’t need a live chat free plugin and the Smash Balloon Instagram plugin._ flu5ky; Source

WP Social Ninja is all about powering your online presence, packed with customization, rock-solid performance, and super-fast support that’s got your back!
